change.summary: The source-part selection mode moves from the model's reply to the harness.
change.cause: A model names an occurrence and quotes the words it means. Whether that quote is the whole atom or a piece of it is a comparison against the source, and the source is the harness's. Asking for it too produced replies that were right about meaning and refused on shape.
change.evidence: EXP_MASTHEAD_METADATA r1 PACK_005: four headings named and quoted correctly, all four refused as UnexpectedVerbatimText, all four scored as false negatives.
change.rejectedAlternative: Letting the binder ignore verbatimText when the reply says WHOLE_ALIAS. That hides the contradiction inside the component whose strictness is the guarantee; canonicalization resolves it before the binder is reached.

model: verbatimText (only when part of an occurrence is meant)
harness: exact UTF-16 start and end offsets
refusal when a quote is absent or ambiguous

v1.status: historical authority, unchanged; every recorded run remains readable against it

v2.pendingModeNote: Internal only. It never reaches the binder, which still refuses any mode it does not know.

canonicalizationRules.given: quote is a proper substring, locatable
quote does not occur in the atom
quote occurs more than once, nothing says which

goldDerivationParity.note: The primary invariant. Every approved part's recorded mode is recovered by comparison alone, with no counterexample in the corpus.

e1Counterfactual.note: A coordinate-shape replay over bytes already captured. 463a758 still records 4 refused and 4 false negatives, because that is what the contract it ran under produced. This does not rewrite it.

contractLayerConsistency.note: Under v1 four layers admitted the shape the binder refused. Under v2 no layer offers it, because no layer names a mode.

requestAuthority.note: Every pack's bytes change, because the schema on the wire changed. That is the intended rebaseline and not a regression: v2 has no recorded runs to preserve.

nonRegression.v1StructuredBinder: unchanged; v2 delegates to it rather than reimplementing resolution

scope: A coordinate-encoding change. It does not make the model better at deciding which text is a heading, and it is not evidence about the three semantic mechanisms. It removes one class of loss in which a correct semantic decision was discarded for its shape.
